title: draba nivalis var. genuina
intro: Draba nivalis var. genuina, commonly known as Arctic draba, is a plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It is a small, perennial plant that grows in cold and mountainous regions, producing white or pink flowers. The health benefits of Draba nivalis var. genuina include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isothiocyanates, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial and anticancer properties.
